name: Guardian Advance's stomp reaches the client without its warrior stance requirement (#6475)
contract: Advance 500170 swaps itself for its stomp 500673 so pressing it again stomps. 500673 still carries the warrior's
Battle and Defensive Stance requirement in Spell.dbc; AscensionGuardian::ApplyContracts clears it for the server
(info->Stances = 0), but the client kept its own row, greyed the stomp out with 'Requires Battle Stance, Defensive
Stance' and would not cast it, so Advance could not be recast. The login spell patch stream now carries the
server's Stances and StancesNot and includes 500673. Expected: the stomp's SMSG_PATCH_SPELL row (2346) is sent

steps.label: Let the login patch stream go out
The stomp's row reaches the client
